node.statement: Existence of an extra fixed class. Let d=dim_R breve-calU=dim_C calX-1>0. Connectedness gives b_0=1, while lem-topology-orientable-top-cohomology applied to the connected compact orientable boundaryless d-manifold gives H^d(breve-calU;reals)!=0 and hence b_d>=1. Since d>0, node 1.9 yields L(breve-sigma)=sum_k b_k>=2, contradicting node 1.7 under the singleton hypothesis. Thus breve-sigma has a fixed class breve-U!=breve-e.
